findings.claim: UntrustedData.MaximumObjectGraphDepth is raised tenfold from 500 to 5000 in a change that has nothing to do with the generator/analyzer crash. Users who deserialize untrusted data get a weaker default limit with no opt-in, so deeply nested payloads that were rejected are now accepted. Deep recursion can approach stack overflow, and a stack overflow is an unrecoverable process crash (DoS). Ledger L9 records a deliberate stack depth limit of 500 even for trusted data.

receipt_plan.detail: Deserialize a payload nested 600 levels (e.g. arrays of one element each) as object with MessagePackSerializerOptions.Standard.WithSecurity(MessagePackSecurity.UntrustedData). Base throws InsufficientExecutionStackException/MessagePackSerializationException; head succeeds. Also try ~5000 depth on a small-stack thread to demonstrate stack overflow risk.

findings.claim: The reportDiagnostic wrapper silently drops every analyzer diagnostic whose location is not in a syntax tree of the current compilation. This is broader than the metadata-crash fix. Diagnostics created with a null location (Location.None), such as the MemberNeedsKey diagnostic that now uses FirstOrDefault()?.GetLocation(), are dropped, as is anything else without a source location. Users who relied on a MsgPack00x error/warning from a case that now yields no location will stop seeing it. Warnings-as-errors users could see their build go from failing to passing.

receipt_plan.detail: Analyzer test: a [MessagePackObject] type whose member lacks [Key] and has a location-less or other-tree symbol (e.g. partial/other-compilation base type member). Compare diagnostics reported on base vs head; MsgPack004 expected on base should still appear on head.

findings.claim: Closed generic metadata types still reach GetObjectInfo, and other DeclaringSyntaxReferences[0] sites are not shown as fixed; only two are changed (the reporter listed lines 735, 1009 and 1101). If line 735 is still unguarded, the crash may persist for the repro. The hunks don't show any fix for it.

receipt_plan.detail: Run generator and analyzer tests with a two-compilation repro (Item<T> record struct in a referenced assembly, Cmd in app). Assert no CS8785/AD0001 and that GeneratedMessagePackResolver is generated.
